name: Claire Durand
source: Claire is an aspiring neurosurgeon that volunteers part-time at the local hospital. Deeply caring and protective of the people she loves, she’s the student everybody loves and respects, despite her spending most of her time studying and doing medical research alone. Claire will do anything to make her classmates happy, and she’ll do so with a smile. She can be rather shy sometimes, so getting her out of her shell can be a challenge.
